description: This file defines a utility class `CommandAndEventJsonExamplesProducer` responsible for generating example JSON files for testing or demonstration purposes related to 'commands' within the Eclipse Ditto project. It creates various JSON representations of 'things' and 'commands' in the context of the Ditto framework, specifically for sudo retrieve commands and their responses, and writes them to specified directories.

classes.name: CommandAndEventJsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class for generating example JSON files related to commands and events in the Eclipse Ditto framework for testing or documentation purposes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that parses command line arguments and initiates JSON generation.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Orchestrates JSON production by resolving the root directory and invoking specific produce methods.

methods.name: produceSudoCommands
methods.description: Generates various 'sudo' command request and response JSON files in a dedicated directory.

methods.name: createExampleThing
methods.description: Creates an example 'Thing' object with predefined permissions and metadata for JSON serialization.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a Jsonifiable object to a JSON string and writes it to a specified file path.
